title: Q-STD-trace-context: Carry one W3C traceparent through tick, workers, queues and dispatched workflows
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** OPEN-STANDARDS-1 register entry `w3c-trace-context` is planned or partial in seed/standards/standards.json
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation openstd --probe w3c-trace-context
**Status:** open

Generate a traceparent at the start of each tick (seed/worker/src/tick.js), pass it on service-binding fetches, queue messages and workflow_dispatch inputs, and emit OpenTelemetry spans with it through seed/worker/src/agentic/adapters/console-telemetry.js.

**Prediction:** tick_runs_with_traceparent_share >= 0.9 within 168 h

**Out of scope:** Running a hosted tracing backend.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation openstd --probe w3c-trace-context` exits 0.
